hotels.title: Stylish Western Sydney Stay in the Heart of Liverpool
hotels.description: Discover polished western Sydney style at this contemporary retreat in Liverpool, moments from the Georges River and the dining precincts of Macquarie Street. Sydney CBD is within easy reach by train, while nearby Casula Powerhouse Arts Centre pairs bold exhibitions with waterfront views and theatre performances. Inside, sleek rooms and suites are complemented by a heated indoor pool, fitness centre and sauna. For dining, the hotel’s restaurant serves modern Australian fare, and Liverpool’s buzzing food scene offers Lebanese feasts at Al Aseel and refined Italian plates at Macquarie Paradiso
